title: The Bellaire Pub & Beer Garden
html:
Short’s Brewing Company’s Bellaire Pub is a vibrant brewpub located in the heart of downtown Bellaire, Michigan. Housed in a historic building, the pub offers a warm and inviting atmosphere where guests can enjoy a wide selection of craft beers brewed on-site, including classics like Local’s Light and Huma Lupa Licious. The menu features a variety of house-made dishes, from pretzels to pizzas, complemented by a curated list of ciders and seltzers.

Just across the street, you’ll find the lively Beer Garden (118 N Bridge St., Bellaire, MI 49615), perfect for soaking up Bellaire’s charming vibe. It's an outdoor venue that hosts live music on Friday and Saturday evenings during the summer months.

Tuesday–Thursday: 11:00 AM – 10:00 PM

title: The Elk Rapids Pull Barn
html:

title: The Bellaire Pub - Guided Brewery Tour
html:
Ever wondered what goes into crafting your favorite Short’s brew? Now's your chance to find out! Short’s Brewing Company offers behind-the-scenes tours at their Bellaire Pub, giving you an insider’s look at the brewing process from start to finish.

Website: https://www.shortsbrewing.com/tours/

Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hB_pr3V0KfA

Tour Highlights:

  • When: Fridays and Saturdays, from 12:00 PM to 4:00 PM. No reservations are required; simply check in at the host stand upon arrival. shortsbrewing.com

  • What to Expect: A guided walk through the innovation brewery where you'll learn about the brewing process, the history of Short’s, and the artistry behind their unique beers.

  • Duration: Approximately 30–45 minutes.

  • Cost: Complimentary with your pub visit.

Pro Tips:

  • Arrive Early: Tours are popular and spots fill up quickly. Arriving a bit early ensures you don't miss out.

  • Stay for a Pint: After the tour, enjoy a freshly poured pint of your favorite Short’s brew in the cozy pub or the lively beer garden.

  • Ask Questions: The staff are passionate about their craft and love sharing their knowledge. Don’t hesitate to ask about the brewing process, ingredients, or the inspiration behind their beers.

Contact Information:

  • Phone: (231) 498-2300

title: Seasonal Beers
html:
At Short’s Brewing, every season brings a fresh lineup of exciting beers crafted to celebrate the flavors and moods of the time of year. Whether it’s a crisp winter pilsner, a bright spring hazy IPA, or a refreshing summer shandy, these limited seasonal brews are only available for a short time — so stock up while you can!

Here’s a taste of what you’ll find rotating through the taps and cans:

title: Fat Tire Biking
html:
Website: https://www.shantycreek.com/ski/more-on-the-snow/#fattirebiking
Contact Here

Looking for a fun winter adventure? Try fat tire biking on snow at Shanty Creek Resorts! The 3km multipurpose trail at Schuss Village is groomed for fat tire biking, snowshoeing, or even a peaceful winter walk with your dog. Bikes are available for rent just minutes away at Paddles & Pedals in downtown Bellaire, making it easy for guests to hit the trails and enjoy Michigan’s snowy outdoors.

title: Glacial Hills Pathway and Natural Area
html:
Website: https://glacialhillstrails.org/
Phone: (231) 533-6023 (Friends of Glacial Hills)
Location: Trailheads on Orchard Hill Rd & Vandermark Rd, Bellaire, MI 49615

Just minutes from downtown Bellaire, this 800-acre trail system offers 31+ miles of multi-use trails for hiking, biking, and winter fat-tire riding. Trails wind through hardwood forests, wildflowers, and rolling terrain—perfect for both casual nature walks and advanced mountain biking.

title: Grass River Natural Area
html:
Website: https://www.grassriver.org/
Phone: (231) 533-8314
Address: 6500 Alden Hwy, Bellaire, MI 49615

Only 10 minutes from Bellaire, this 1,492-acre preserve features 7 miles of boardwalk and natural trails through wetlands, meadows, and forests. Guests love the peaceful setting, birdwatching opportunities, and guided nature programs. A great family-friendly stop for an easy stroll in nature.

title: Schuss Mountain & Shanty Creek Resorts Trails
html:
Website: https://www.shantycreek.com/stay/antrim-county/#glacialhills
Phone: (866) 695-5010
Address: 5780 Shanty Creek Rd, Bellaire, MI 49615

Located just outside Bellaire, Shanty Creek offers scenic mountain biking trails, hiking paths, and winter cross-country skiing. Trails range from beginner loops to challenging terrain across Schuss and Summit Mountains, with beautiful views of northern Michigan landscapes.

title: Jordan River Pathway (East Jordan)
html:
Website: https://www.alltrails.com/trail/us/michigan/jordan-valley-pathway--3
Phone: (231) 582-9191 (MDNR)
Trailhead: Deadman’s Hill Scenic Overlook, Deadman’s Hill Rd, Elmira, MI 49730 (20 min from Bellaire)

More Info Here

A popular 18-mile loop trail through the Jordan River Valley, with shorter day-hike options available. Guests rave about the stunning river views, wildlife, and forest landscapes. Perfect for experienced hikers looking for a half-day or overnight backpacking trip.
